game.name: Pokémon Reloaded
game.desc: Pokémon Reloaded The Last Beta 1.9.2.2 running natively on OpenGMK. Explore the Star region, catch Pokémon and battle in this long-running Spanish fan game. Single-player controls: L1 attack 4, R1 capture, Select+face buttons switch Pokémon. Game files are not included; download them from the official F3R blog.
